title: Bix Beiderbecke and the Paul Whiteman band
summary: He found Bix new, exciting and beautiful, and enjoyed Whiteman's band only when Bix was in it.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Now what did you -- do you remember what you thought of some of Bix's playing for instance?
It was an entirely new thing, I thought it was very exciting and very beautiful. I liked what Bix was doing.
Entirely different and I thought it was as nice to listen to as Louis Armstrong, also was different.
Well Rex Stewart was very taken by Bix, apparently.
And what about the Paul Whiteman band, for instance, did you like that kind of music?
I didn't like Paul Whiteman's band. Only time I enjoyed Paul Whiteman was when Bix was in the band. The only time. It was a good band. It was a good band, but
it didn't move me too much. Very well played band, I have to say that.
